City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 3
(Absence or Disability of Mayor)

Summary:  Amendment to Article III, Section 3-05 of the Home Rule Charter to allow the city council to appoint a person to serve as acting mayor if the director of administration is unable to serve.

contests.title: City of Hammond HRC Am.- 4 -- Council Legal Advisor - CC
contests.summary:
City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 4
(Council Legal Advisor)

Summary:  Amendment to Article IV, Section 4-02 of the Home Rule Charter to add a Subsection E to allow the council to hire a separate legal advisor.

contests.title: City of Hammond HRC Am.- 5 -- Police Chief Qualifications - CC
contests.summary:
City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 5
(Police Chief Qualifications)

Summary:  Amendment to Article IV, Section 4-04 of the Home Rule Charter to add a Subsection C to provide for the qualifications of the police chief.

contests.title: City of Hammond HRC Am.- 6 -- Fire Chief Qualifications - CC
contests.summary:
City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 6
(Fire Chief Qualifications)

Summary:  Amendment to Article IV, Section 4-05 of the Home Rule Charter to add a Subsection C to provide for the qualifications of the fire chief.

contests.title: City of Hammond HRC Am.- 7 -- Conflicts of Interest - CC
contests.summary:
City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 7
(Conflicts of Interest)

Summary:  Amendment to Article VII, Section 7-02 of the Home Rule Charter to expand the prohibition against conflicts of interests to include interests in limited liability corporations and partnerships.

contests.title: City of Hammond HRC Am.- 8 -- Amendment/Replacement
contests.summary:
City of Hammond Charter Amendment Propositions
Charter Amendment Proposition No. 8
(Amendment or Replacement)

Summary:  Amendment to Article VII, Section 7-04 of the Home Rule Charter to change the word "repeal" to the word "replace".
